defect_summary: VERIFY_TARGET ran after ALIGN_VERSION while FINDINGS, DESCRIBE, and the release record still said 0.6.0, so ./nlc verify failed.
unsuitable_process: next_prepare_action selects VERIFY_TARGET immediately after ALIGN_VERSION. ALIGN_VERSION only bumps nlc-version.json. F1 fitness requires FINDINGS/DESCRIBE to match identity, which PREP/WRITE_RECORD own. That order is an impossible REPAIR under ADR 0049.
climb_steps: ALIGN_VERSION had already set nlc-version.json to 0.7.0.
PREP and WRITE_RECORD come after VERIFY_TARGET in next_prepare_action.
ADR 0049: a REPAIR must be able to move its progress fact.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
